title: Request a delivery
subtitle: Tell us what needs to go where. We’ll confirm the price and collection time before you book.

step1.locationBlocked: Location is unavailable in this browser view. Open the page in your regular browser, or type the address.

sidebar.directAssignmentDesc: Your request goes directly to the driver on the corridor. No third parties.
sidebar.liveGpsDesc: Once confirmed, you'll receive a live location pin of your driver.

errors.alreadySubmitted: This enquiry was already saved. Contact dispatch to change it.
errors.submitFailed: Your enquiry could not be saved. Please try again or call dispatch.
errors.routeMismatch: Choose both regions and check that each address matches its selected region.
errors.scheduleInvalid: Choose a future pickup time and a delivery deadline after pickup.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid contact number, including your country code.

expiredLink.title: That delivery link has expired
expiredLink.body: Tracking links close 24 hours after delivery. Need your Chain of Custody certificate? Call or WhatsApp dispatch and we'll send it. Or book your next delivery below.
expiredLink.whatsappText: Hi Nokael, I need the Chain of Custody certificate for a completed delivery.

summary.heading: Your delivery
summary.priceNote: This is a starting price. Your route, item and timing determine the final quote.
summary.next1: We check your route and available drivers.
summary.next2: You receive a price and estimated collection time.
summary.next3: You confirm before a driver is dispatched.
summary.helpBody: For a time-sensitive delivery, contact dispatch directly.

1.title: Where are we collecting and delivering?
1.body: Choose an emirate and enter a building, area or street address for each stop.

2.title: What are you sending?
2.body: Choose the option that best describes your item.

3.title: When do you need the delivery?
3.body: Tell us your preferred timing. Availability is confirmed with your quote.

4.title: How can we reach you?
4.body: We’ll use these details to discuss your delivery and send your quote.
